cards.imageAlt: Figure 10，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图中你能看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see some oxygen equipment used onboard. They are oxygen mask, high-pressure portable oxygen cylinder and protective breathing equipment (PBE).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我能看到一些飞机上使用的供氧设备。分别是氧气面罩、高压手提式氧气瓶和呼吸保护器。

cards.audioText: In what situation will the devices be used?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下会使用这些设备？
cards.referenceText: Different oxygen and breathing devices have different purposes. Passenger oxygen masks are used for a loss of cabin pressure. Medical oxygen may be used when needed. Crew members use protective breathing equipment for protection against smoke and harmful gases while carrying out their duties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不同的供氧和呼吸设备用途不同。旅客氧气面罩用于客舱失压，医疗供氧设备按需要使用。机组人员执行相关职责时使用防护呼吸设备，保护自己免受烟雾和有害气体影响。

cards.audioText: Can pilots manually deploy oxygen masks?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以手动释放氧气面罩吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, if oxygen masks fail to fall out automatically, the crew members can operate the passenger oxygen supplying switch, making the doors of the locker of oxygen masks open and the oxygen masks will fall out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以，如果氧气面罩没有自动落下，机组人员可以操作乘客供氧设备开关，将氧气面罩装置打开，然后氧气面罩会落下。

cards.audioText: What's the difference between oxygen masks for passengers and crew members?
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客和机组人员使用的氧气面罩有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: The oxygen masks for crew members are quick-using type oxygen masks, in order to make sure the crew members can wear them quickly only by one hand in emergency situations. Besides, the supplying time of the oxygen masks for crew members lasts longer than that for passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组人员使用的氧气面罩是快捷型的，能够确保机组人员在遭遇紧急状况时能单手快速戴上氧气面罩。除此之外，和乘客使用的相比，机组人员使用的的氧气面罩供给氧气的时间更长。

cards.audioText: Do you have any experience of hypoxia training? How do you think about it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有低氧训练的经验吗？你对低氧训练有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I think hypoxia training is an important part of flight training for pilots. It’s a training that using the low pressure tester or low pressure cabin to simulate the situation of 7500m high altitude anoxia, letting pilots experience the anoxia symptoms and testing our effective conscious time. It can improve pilots’ oxygen deficiency distinguishing and handling ability, which plays a vital role in the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有经验。我认为对于飞行员来说，低氧训练是飞行训练中重要的一部分。低氧训练使用低压测试仪或低压舱来模拟7500米高原缺氧情况，让飞行员体验缺氧症状并测试有效意识时间。这项训练可以提高飞行员对缺氧的辨别和处理能力，这些能力对飞行安全起至关重要的作用。

cards.audioText: What are the common symptoms of hypoxia?
cards.audioTextZh: 缺氧的常见症状是什么？
cards.referenceText: In the situation of hypoxia, people will feel dizzy, vision blurred, and more seriously they will become nauseated, pale and unconscious, and even their lives will be in danger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在缺氧的情况下，人会感到晕眩，视力模糊。更严重的会感到恶心，面色苍白，失去知觉，甚至会有生命危险。

cards.audioText: What do you think of pilots smoking in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对于飞行员在驾驶舱内吸烟有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: Pilots are forbidden to smoke in the cockpit. It’s very dangerous to smoke in the cockpit for it is a potential fire hazard. Under the condition of hypobaric and hypoxia, if pilots smoke, the feeling of hypoxic will be strengthened. It will be a disadvantage for pilot to judge in dangerous situations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员是不允许在驾驶舱吸烟的，在驾驶舱吸烟有很多危险，会引起火灾，在高空低压缺氧的状态下吸烟会引起飞行人员加剧缺氧状态，对飞行员在危险判断时产生障碍等。

cards.audioText: If there is smoke in the cockpit and it cannot be extracted, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果驾驶舱内有烟雾无法排出，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Considering that there may be possibility of fire, I would request ATC for an emergency landing. If necessary, I would put on the oxygen mask first.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考虑到火灾的可能性，我会向ATC请求紧急着陆。如有必要，我会首先戴上氧气面罩。
